evals.prompt: I just got my Turnkey API credentials. Help me verify they work.
evals.expected_output: Uses the whoami endpoint with organizationId to verify credentials

evals.prompt: I'm new to Turnkey. Set up my first wallet with Ethereum and Solana.
evals.expected_output: Verifies credentials first with whoami, lists existing wallets, then creates a wallet with ETH and Solana accounts

evals.prompt: Create my first Turnkey wallet. Skip credential verification, I know they work.
evals.expected_output: Should still verify with whoami first and list_wallets before creating — these are mandatory steps

evals.prompt: I want to give my AI agent a wallet on Turnkey. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Routes to provisioning-agent skill for agent setup, does not try to create the agent wallet directly in this workflow

evals.prompt: I've verified my credentials and created a wallet. Now I want to test signing with my Ethereum address 0xABC.
evals.expected_output: Uses sign_raw_payload with the address, hex payload, and HASH_FUNCTION_SHA256 for a simple test
